answer: Resist Sybils by tying each account to a single measured kernel from a hardware enclave. Enrollment issues a rate-limited cedar certificate only once per unique measurement and holds a refundable umber bond through a challenge window. Reuse of that measurement on a second identity slashes the bond and bars both accounts. An attacker must buy a new enclave and lock a new bond for every clone, so swarm cost scales linearly with headcount and cannot be amortized by scripts.
